items.title: Unemployment at five-year high after nearly 40,000 jobs lost
items.summary: An estimated 39,300 fewer Australians were in work last month, while the number of unemployed people increased by 8,900.

items.title: Stock Market Today: Dow Jumps 450 Points As Yields Dive; Eli Lilly Charges Higher (Live Coverage)
items.summary: The Dow Jones index rises Thursday while the Nasdaq slides on further tech weakness.

items.title: South32 shareholders to vote on $8 billion Alcoa asset sale
items.summary: South32 Ltd (LSE:S32, ASX:S32, FRA:32Z, OTC:SHTLF, JSE:S32) shareholders will vote today on the proposed $8 billion sale of its aluminium and alumina assets to Alcoa (NYSE:AA), a transaction that would reshape the miner's portfolio and accelerate its transition towards higher-growth base...

aus.headline: Unemployment At Five-Year High
aus.body: Nearly 40,000 jobs vanished last month as the number out of work rose by 8,900.
aus.why: More Australians are now hunting for work.

us.headline: Dow Climbs 450 Points As Yields Drop
us.body: The Dow rose 450 points on Thursday while the Nasdaq fell on more tech weakness.
us.why: Many Australians hold US shares through their super.

biz.headline: South32 Puts $8b Sale To Shareholders
biz.body: South32 investors were set to vote on an $8b sale of its aluminium assets to Alcoa.
biz.why: The deal would reshape one of the ASX big miners.
